description: This file defines the `XBRLBuilder` class responsible for constructing XBRL (eXtensible Business Reporting Language) XML documents based on provided financial data. It includes methods to build XML structures, add contexts, units, and taxonomies, and handle date formatting and namespace management for generating compliant XBRL reports.

classes.name: XBRLBuilder
classes.description: A Spring component that constructs XBRL XML documents from financial data, handling namespace management, context creation, units, and taxonomy elements.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Main method that generates an XBRL XML string from `XBRLData` object containing Map of taxonomies and values, start/end dates, and currency.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overloaded method that builds an XBRL document from a Map of `MixTaxonomyData` and corresponding BigDecimal values, along with start and end dates and currency.

methods.name: addTaxonomy
methods.description: Adds a taxonomy element to the XBRL document, setting attributes, context references, and handling namespace and dimension info.

methods.name: getUnitRef
methods.description: Determines the unit reference ID based on whether the taxonomy is a portfolio or not.

methods.name: addNumberUnit
methods.description: Adds a generic number unit element to the XBRL document.

methods.name: addCurrencyUnit
methods.description: Adds the currency unit element to the XBRL document with the specified currency code.

methods.name: addContexts
methods.description: Creates and adds context elements to the XBRL document based on start and end dates and context data.

methods.name: getNumberOfDecimalPlaces
methods.description: Calculates the number of decimal places in a BigDecimal value after stripping trailing zeros.
